Two people who may be worth considering to be the invited “experts” (
importantly, both are friends of the lab, meaning that they should be trustworthy :)
Current PhD student (close to the end of the programme). In his words, his research is focused on “
the study of the social foundations of interactions between humans and artificial intelligence”.
One of the co-founders of Mind Easy, a bio-tech start up which “
develops systems based on AI and biometrics that enable dynamic adaptation of the environment and content to the user's psychophysiological state”.
An external lecturer at NCU, and

Training and Development Specialist at Torun Technology Park. According to one of his profiles, he “facilitates workshops and training sessions aimed at fostering innovation and entrepreneurship among students and young professionals”. He is currently a board manager at a company called SIMPLITO, which advertises that one of its tasks is developing the “
DeepFellow Framework for deploying private AI in local infrastructure and creating dedicated agents”.
This is how Roland describes himself on his linkedin:
I build ML models of language — and I evaluate whether today's LLMs actually understand it.

My current work develops novel calibration metrics (ESR, CDS) to benchmark frontier models (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) on fine-grained social and pragmatic tasks. A paper on this work was accepted at CMCL 2026, with a follow-up targeting ACL/EMNLP.

My background spans Computer Science (BSc, Paderborn), Interdisciplinary Media Studies (MSc, Bielefeld), and Computational Linguistics (PhD, Tübingen) — 15+ years of rigorous modeling across game theory, multi-agent RL, probabilistic NLP, and now transformer-based evaluation.”

Monika is an AI advisor, who is closely tied to the lab, and has worked with NCU on big projects before (grant preparation etc.). I think she would have a lot of expertise from the practical side - preparing agents for specialised tasks, etc.
Darek is a biologist, but I assume he must have some AI expertise if Sławek recommends him. I couldn’t find too much info, so Sławek would have to chip in and specify.
